The two independently written integer programs check all 5658+302858 orientations and agree on rank and equality counters. The bounded 4x4 minors preclude C++ overflow. The universal real-input inequality thus follows from the analytic reduction plus exact exhaustive integer arithmetic, not a sampled grid. Endpoint impulses attain (n-1)/n.
